source_refs.note: Topic 9.5.2 (PDF 218-219, printed 215-216). The saving prints 'Rs. 10.000'; the yearly total is worked. The gold caution is general knowledge, flagged. Short question 7 is answered.

items: Investment: putting money into a business or project to earn future profit; an Islamabad clothing store invests Rs 50,000 in new stock expecting to sell it for more.
Savings: setting money aside for future needs, such as equipment, expansion or emergencies; a Peshawar restaurant saving Rs 10,000 a month has Rs 120,000 after a year for a new oven.

blocks.text: The book notes that many people in Pakistan save by buying gold, which is seen as a safe store of value. Like any asset, gold's price can also fall, so this is a description of a common practice, not advice.

blocks.prompt: Describe one financial concept important for business (short question 7).
blocks.explanation: Profit: revenue minus all costs. It shows whether the business actually makes money, and part of it can be saved or reinvested to grow.

items: Investment spends now to earn later; savings set money aside (Rs 10,000 x 12 = Rs 120,000).
